question: With pay-cost-of-novelty work-compression FALSIFIED for parameterized inheritance at freshness 0.25 under honest kernel-gated cost (SPIDER/RAG per_hit 1.0 at n0 and 1.57 at n0.25, SPIDER/STAGEHAND 1.61 at n0, 71.8% UNKNOWN artifact rho 0.82 is binary gating not proportional), does pivoting to curated exploration plus MEA auditor harness (fresh-context execution with external verified state before registry update) plus TTL/ETag verification probe achieve honest-cost per_hit targets that parameterization failed — SPIDER/RAG-EMBED per_hit <=0.85 at n0 and n0.25 and SPIDER/STAGEHAND per_hit <=1.20 at n0 and SPIDER/TERX per_hit <1.0 at n>=0.25 with false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15 — and what is the Pareto (accuracy vs tokens vs browser+latency) vs COLD/RAG/Stagehand on same 192/36 WebArena-Verified v2 census and on Docker full-DOM 2000-node BrowserGym 1280x720 with real gpt-4o-mini tokens/browser calls under family-stratified bootstrap 5000 and block-permutation 5000?
hypothesis: A pivoted SPIDER product kernel that replaces slot-parameterization leverage with governed-memory leverage — (a) curated exploration: 5 demos per family selected by external verified state (next_state hash verified, not random A-pool) before distill, (b) MEA auditor harness: every resolve executes in fresh LLM context (no history carryover, context <=25k truncated), fetches external verified state (MockEnv verified_state hash + provenance fetch 100 tok+1 call) before registry write, and only promotes Mechanism to registry after verification passes (MemGuard/VerMem persistent verifier governance), (c) TTL/ETag verification probe: cheap conditional probe (HEAD with ETag/If-None-Match and TTL check via gunicorn+nginx loopback 10 tok+30ms) instead of full 50 tok+120ms verify, with SWR fallback to full verify on probe miss — will under identical honest kernel-gated cost accounting (branch-derived sums, no n*3200 formula, f=10 amortization, retrieval 200/verify_probe 10/full_verify 50/hit 50/novel 500/repair 500/distill 1000, plus auditor_harness 100 tok audit cost) achieve at n0 and n0.25 per_hit parity beating shipped RAG (<=0.85x) and parity to Stagehand cache (<=1.20x at n0) and beating TERX (<1.0 at n>=0.25) where parameterized inheritance failed, while maintaining false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE_exec<=0.15, because leverage shifts from slot induction to verification/provenance plus selective invalidation and context budgeting that addresses prior 71.8% UNKNOWN vacuity and verification/abstention miscalibration. Tested paired on 192/36 file census (primary gate) and exploratory Docker full-DOM 2000-node BrowserGym 1280x720 with real gpt-4o-mini tokens/browser calls if runtime distributed-store+BrowserGym CDP substrate available, with family-stratified bootstrap 5000 and block-permutation 5000.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if controls PASS (PC1-PC4 non-degenerate) but any of: (F1) SPIDER-MEA per_hit vs B-RAG-EMBED per_hit >0.85 at n0 OR at n0.25 (both required <=0.85); (F2) SPIDER-MEA per_hit vs B-STAGEHAND-CACHE per_hit >1.20 at n0; (F3) SPIDER-MEA per_hit vs B-TERX-REPLAY per_hit >=1.0 at any n in {0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} (requires <1.0 at every n>=0.25); (F4) false_accept>0.10 or UNKNOWN_precision<0.85 or ECE_exec>0.15 on verification-derived execution rows with non-vacuous MockEnv wrong-bound p=0.15; (F5) curated vs uncurated ablation shows no delta (proving curated exploration adds no value beyond random A-pool) and MEA harness shows no delta vs no-harness (proving governance irrelevant). MIXED if file-based per_hit targets pass but Docker real-cost correlation rho_proxy_real <0.50 or Docker Pareto dominated by Stagehand (usd cost higher at same accuracy). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC1-PC4 fail (exact-repeat not 1.0, MEA binding not 1.0, TTL/ETag probe not discriminating fresh vs stale, auditor not blocking unverified writes), or bijective formula detected, or registry never consulted, or UNKNOWN never exercised (<5% UNKNOWN at n=1), or baselines starved (hit_rate 0 at n=0 inside compared set), or degenerate CI [1,1] used as precision, or nonce reuse bypasses ETag. Precedence: any PC failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID irrespective of F1-F5; if NC1 shuffled shows rho>=0.35 significant -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (novelty confounded).

baselines.description: Cold start: no SPIDER memory. Branch-derived cost 500 tok +2 browser calls per novel step, 50 tok+120ms verify per step, no retrieval, no auditor. Paired on identical 192-task family-stratified splits at each n. Denominator for saving. Success 1.0 via deterministic mock (cost discriminated, not rate). Excludes retrieval/distill/auditor overhead.
baselines.expected: Cost flat vs n (|rho|~0) at ~L*500. Per_hit flat ~500. Saving denominator. No UNKNOWN; full exploration each task.

baselines.description: RAG semantic retrieval over prior curated A under QCR frozen-bank same-ranker: frozen bank 36 families Curated-A demos, TFIDF Jaccard fallback TAU0.30 identical ranker for all systems, top-1 verbatim bind with verify fallback to COLD on miss. Retrieval 200 tok+150ms. Honestly retrievable at n=0 (overlap 1.0) and proportionally at n=0.25 (partial overlap = realized novelty). Post-retrieval verbatim only, no parameterization, no MEA harness, no TTL probe. QCR varies only post-retrieval support.
baselines.expected: Hit cost ~50 per_hit at n0 near SPIDER-MEA; at n>=0.25 worse than curated+MEA if governance helps. SPIDER-MEA per_hit must beat >=15% at n0 and n0.25 (ratio<=0.85) to survive.

Hit iff DOM identical (n=0 exact repeat, 36 tasks) else COLD. Honest hit cost 50 tok+120ms +1 browser call. Shipped baseline already at 80% speedup. Same splits, same L.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate 1.0 at n=0 -> per_hit ~50+ retrieval amort. 0 at n>=0.25. SPIDER-MEA per_hit parity <=1.20x at n0 allowed; must be cheaper per_hit at n>=0.25 via TTL probe vs binary cache.

baselines.description: TERX/BrowserBash 0-token exact replay+LLM fallback under QCR: if test identifier sequence exactly equals training trajectory (n=0 exact repeat) replay at 0 LLM step tokens+50 tok verify+1 browser call ~90-120ms; else fallback to COLD (500 tok/step). Honest 50 tok verify, not 400. HitRate 1.0 at n0, 0 at n>=0.25. Same 192 splits.
baselines.expected: Per_hit ~50 at n0, ~500 at n>=0.25. SPIDER-MEA per_hit must be <1.0 vs TERX at every n>=0.25 to show selective invalidation beats binary replay.

baselines.description: PRODUCT SUT pivoted: curated exploration (5 demos/family filtered by external verified_state before distill) + MEA auditor harness (fresh-context resolve with external verified_state fetch before registry update, 100 tok auditor cost, provenance graph, context truncation at 25k) + TTL/ETag verification probe (10 tok+30ms conditional HEAD with ETag/If-None-Match and TTL via gunicorn+nginx loopback, fallback to full 50 tok verify on stale/miss) + behavioral freshness gating 0.25 + confidence softmax temp0.15+jitter UNKNOWN<0.80 + verify+repair (500 tok+2 calls on fail) fallback to COLD on UNKNOWN. Registry MechanismRegistry, _bind, amortized distill 1000/f (f=10) plus auditor 100/f only SUT. Genuine branch-derived cost sums of executed retrieval/auditor/probe/verify/exec/repair. Non-deterministic MockEnv wrong-bound p=0.15 on shuffled/random binding. QCR frozen bank same ranker. Reports M_total_f10 and M_per_hit=(M_total_f10 - retrieval - distill - auditor)/L plus Pareto tokens/browser/latency/probe split and critique-reconstruct adapter for retrieval+reconstruction accounting.
baselines.expected: At n0 success>=0.85 per_hit parity to Stagehand/TERX <=1.20, beating RAG <=0.85 at n0 and n0.25, beating TERX <1.0 at n>=0.25, false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15, TTL probe hitRate ~0.80 at n0 with probe->verify 10+30ms dominating adaptive Jaccard, auditor prevents false_accept from unverified writes, curated exploration raises verified state coverage vs random.

positive_control.description: PC1 Exact-repeat cache: B-TERX-REPLAY and B-STAGEHAND-CACHE at n=0 exact-repeat (test seq == training trajectory) must achieve hit_rate 1.0 inside compared set, 50 tok verify-only per_hit, success 1.0, proving substrate can measure 0-cost case. PC2 MEA binding+governance: SPIDER-MEA curated on 5 demos per family on Curated-A must resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action via actual src/spider/kernel.py _bind on held Curated-A at n=0 (5/5 per-family spot-check, family-stratified), binding_correctness 1.0, and unverified Mechanism must NOT be promoted (auditor blocks write until external verified_state passes). Failure of any PC -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.

measurement_validity: 1. Census fidelity (reuse proven): WebArena-Verified v2 192 tasks /36 families >=3 /49 templates /duplication 0.9479 /param_task 0.8958 /L 8-14 family-specific slots ${sku},${store_id},${variant},${category} via actual src/spider/kernel.py distill (Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor, structure-similarity>=0.75, field-path relevance body.*|headers.*|url). Load /tmp/webarena or repo-cached JSON if present; else generate synthetic family-structured mock replicating exactly 36/49 ratios and log provenance, disclose ceiling as synthetic file-based not Docker/full-DOM (192/36). Manifest+hashes+seeds logged. Curated-A = subset of A filtered by external verified_state (MockEnv verified_state hash matches observed next_state hash) with provenance bearing; uncurated-A = random A of same size for ablation.

2. MEA auditor harness operational definition: MEA = fresh-context execution (LLM context truncated at 25k tokens, no cross-task history, retrieval injected at 25k boundary with provenance graph), external verified state fetch (MockEnv verified_state hash fetch 100 tok+1 call, provenance graph node) BEFORE registry distill/update, and governance gate: distill promotes only after verify(verified_state) passes; otherwise Mechanism remains PENDING not EXECUTABLE. All fetches logged with SHA256. Directly addresses Scout long-context 25k-150k degradation and evidence-tracing prior. Code path src/spider/kernel.py + src/spider/auditor_harness.py (or harness in run_experiment.py if kernel not yet promoted) with honest cost counters.

3. TTL/ETag verification probe operational definition: probe = conditional HTTP HEAD/GET with If-None-Match ETag and TTL check against gunicorn+nginx loopback fixture (nginx serves W/"body_sha" ETag, Cache-Control max-age=60, Last-Modified). Probe cost 10 tok+30ms+1 browser call; on 304 Not Modified or TTL valid -> hit (fresh, no full verify); on expired TTL or ETag mismatch -> fallback to full verify 50 tok+120ms+1 call and repair path. Probe vs full verify instrumented per step. Honest cost counters kernel-gated (no n*3200 formula) summed from branch traces; auditor verifies no formula path via code inspection.

4. Controlled novelty hold-out within family under QCR: per-family disjoint Curated-A(train)/B(test never-observed) pools zero overlap, frozen bank TFIDF Jaccard TAU0.30 same ranker for all retrievers. Fractions n {0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} realized by sampling test tasks where n fraction of parameterizable slots drawn from B and (1-n) from Curated-A stratified by slot position, header vs url channel, and family. n=0 are exact-repeat sequences so TERX/Stagehand hitRate 1.0 reachable. Train 5 demos/family on Curated-A only; registry one Mechanism/family via actual distill. All fit on TRAIN only. QCR frozen bank same ranker. Realized novelty disclosed per task for S=1/2 families.

5. Length co-variation disclosure and per-hit isolation: L family-specific 8-14 constant within family varies across families; report per-family L distribution. Novelty n and L orthogonal within strata. Primary discriminant for |rho_length| is M_per_hit=(M_total_f10 - retrieval - distill_amort - auditor_amort)/L excluding fixed retrieval/distill/auditor (f=10) per Director mandate; secondary M_total_f10. Report also M_per_hit_probe_split (probe vs fullVerify). This isolates step cost from fixed overhead, removing binary-gating artifact. No shuffling within strata.

6. Strong baselines identical splits honest accounting retrievable under QCR: all baselines same 192 tasks same probe/verify fallback to COLD on miss, same frozen bank same ranker. B-RAG-EMBED proportionally retrievable at n=0.25 (partial overlap) not binary n=0-only. B-STAGEHAND-CACHE DOM-hash (2000 nodes 1280x720) logic honest 50 tok hit, B-TERX string equality. Hit cost 50 tok per spec (not 400) and RAG retrieval+verify honest. Per-hit excludes retrieval/distill/auditor for parity; total includes them. None starved; hitRate n=0 must be 1.0 inside compared set. Distill+auditor only SUT. Critique-reconstruct adapter (Frontier) logs retrieval+reconstruction cost accounting separately for Pareto.

7. Honest kernel-gated cost accounting (no formula, critique-reconstruct): every per-task cost is sum of executed branches: retrieval 200 tok+150ms, auditor_fetch 100 tok+80ms (SUT only), probe 10 tok+30ms vs fullVerify 50+120ms, hit 50+1 call, novel/failed 500+2 calls, repair 500+2, distill 1000/f and auditor 100/f amortized f=10 per Director. No 250+500*int(10n) bijective nor n*3200. Distill+auditor only P-SPIDER-MEA. If gpt-4o-mini+Playwright Docker available, add real token/browser/latency alongside proxy with correlation rho_proxy_real; otherwise disclose proxy-only and bound ceiling to file-based mock. Branch traces logged with per-step cost breakdown including probeHit flag and ETag matched flag.

8. Abstention/calibration measured not assigned with non-vacuous mock: UNKNOWN_precision=TP_UNKNOWN/(TP+FP_UNKNOWN) where UNKNOWN correct when freshness <0.25 or confidence<0.80 or auditor rejects or probe indicates stale and would-verify would fail (mock wrong-bound 15% failure enables discrimination); false_accept=EXECUTABLE wrong binding failing verify on mock 15% wrong-bound rate. Both verification-derived not hash-assigned. Confidence via softmax temp0.15+uniform jitter [-0.05,0.05] seeded not linear 0.95-n*0.12. ECE 5-bin derived confidence vs correctness (EXEC rows only), 3 empty bins disclosed, bootstrap 2000 for ECE CI per stratum+pooled, confidence_std>0.05 required. Probe ECE and auditor ECE reported separately. Thresholds false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15 verification-derived non-vacuous (PC4 ensures mock can fail).

9. Statistics with provenance and retrieval-use gap: primary Spearman rho between per-task M_per_hit and novelty n (and secondary rho_total) family-stratified N~192 block-permutation primary (family-label permutation 5000) and 5000 family-stratified bootstrap (resample families with replacement then tasks within) for 95% CI on rho,R2_delta,cost ratios,rho_length,probe_saving,auditor_precision respecting dependency. Linear regressions cost~novelty and cost~length per stratum heteroscedasticity-robust SE for both M_per_hit and M_total_f10. Retrieval success vs utilization gap logged (retrieved vs executed). Critique-reconstruct adapter tracks reconstruction cost. Degenerate CI [1,1] flagged degenerate not precision. ANOVA novelty*length if p<0.05 disclose within-stratum rho_length on M_per_hit.

10. Docker full-DOM 2000-node BrowserGym 1280x720 with real gpt-4o-mini tokens/browser calls (exploratory but fully instrumented): if runtime distributed-store + BrowserGym CDP AX provenance (gunicorn+nginx loopback) available, replicate 192/36 census (or 36-family subset if cost) with Playwright 1280x720 CDP AX tree hash 2000 nodes, full DOM snapshot, real gpt-4o-mini 15-step budget temp0 seed42, measuring real tokens/browser_calls/latency_ms/probe_latency_ms and reporting Pareto alongside proxy with rho_proxy_real correlation; if substrate unavailable or fails health check (<80% AX>10 nodes), disclose as not executed, retain proxy-only conclusion bounded to file-based mock, log failure.json with smallest next action (runtime distributed-store repair). QCR bank hash and Docker availability flag in provenance. No outcome-bearing measurement before freeze; freeze.json hashes request/spec/prereg+code hashes before result.json.
decision_rule: All thresholds family-stratified pooled N~192 file-based census primary (proxy branch-derived); gpt-4o-mini+Playwright Docker replication exploratory if available does not gate SURVIVES but informs Pareto and rho_proxy_real. Compute per-method success,false_accept,UNKNOWN_precision,ECE_exec 5-bin,M_total_f10,M_per_hit per task,Spearman rho_novelty on M_per_hit (primary) and M_total_f10 (secondary),R2_novelty,R2_length per stratum and pooled R2_delta per_hit,rho_length per stratum per_hit,Wilson95% for rates,family-stratified bootstrap5000 for rho/R2/ratio/CIs,block-permutation5000 p for rho,pareto tokens/browser/latency/probe/auditor split,ttl_probe hitRate and latency saving,auditor governance blockRate,curated vs uncurated delta. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (C1) correctness+calibration: SPIDER-MEA success at n0 >=0.85 (Wilson lower>=0.72) mean success across n bins >=0.80 false_accept<=0.10 overall UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE_exec<=0.15 (5-bin derived confidence std>0.05, 3 empty bins disclosed, PC4 non-vacuous verified) verification-derived; (C2) positive controls: PC1 B-TERX and B-STAGEHAND hitRate 1.0 at n0 inside compared set 50 tok verify-only per_hit success1.0, PC2 SPIDER-MEA binding 5/5 per family at n0 via actual _bind correctness1.0 and auditor blocks 100% unverified writes, PC3 TTL/ETag probe discrimination fresh vs stale accuracy>=0.90 latency saving>=30% vs full verify, PC4 NC2 forced wrong-bound false_accept in [0.10,0.60] proving non-vacuous mock — failure of any PC ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID irrespective of C3-C6; (C3) pivot per_hit economics (Director PIVOT targets that parameterization failed): P-SPIDER-MEA per_hit vs B-RAG-EMBED per_hit <=0.85 at n0 AND at n0.25, vs B-STAGEHAND-CACHE per_hit <=1.20 at n0, vs B-TERX-REPLAY per_hit <1.0 at every n in {0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} under QCR honest accounting with family-stratified bootstrap95% CIs non-overlapping where needed, slope>0 p<0.01; (C4) governance invariants: probe_false_accept<0.05 auditor_blockRate 1.0 on unverified hash, curated vs uncurated delta success>0.10 or false_accept delta >0.10 proving curated+auditor causal; (C5) work compression side checks: SPIDER-MEA/COLD on M_total_f10 <=0.75 at n0 (>=25% saving) AND <=1.10 at n1 via UNKNOWN for amortization sanity; (C6) null controls: NC1 shuffled on M_per_hit |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 success<=COLD or false_accept 0.10-0.60 and auditor UNKNOWN>=0.80, NC2 false_accept>=0.10 or |rho|<0.35, NC3 |rho|<0.25 R2<0.15 on M_per_hit. Precedence: C2 fails ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID irrespective of C3-C6; if C2 passes but C3 any threshold fails ->FALSIFIED (pivot does not achieve per_hit targets); if NC1 shows rho>=0.35 significant ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Pareto dominance (accuracy vs tokens vs browser+latency decomposed tokens/browser/retrieval/verification/probe/auditor) reported; Docker Pareto and rho_proxy_real reported if available but not gating SURVIVES. All thresholds two-sided alpha0.01 primary, calibration alpha0.05 secondary. File-based SURVIVES advances to Docker replication gate before PRODUCT_CORE.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES family-stratified on M_per_hit at f=10 with PC1-PC4 PASS: C-PRODUCT-ECON advances HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL bounded to WebArena-Verified v2 file-based census 192/36 proxy with curated exploration + MEA auditor harness (fresh-context + external verified state) + TTL/ETag probe (gunicorn+nginx loopback probe 10 tok+30ms) under QCR (frozen bank TAU0.30 same ranker) and honest kernel-gated cost (branch sums, probe/auditor counters). First non-parameterization evidence that governed-memory + cheap verification achieves honest-cost per_hit targets parameterization failed (<=0.85x RAG at n0 and n0.25, <=1.20x Stagehand at n0, <1.0x TERX at n>=0.25) with false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15. Unblocks C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY amortized interpretation via validation rather than slot induction and C-FRESHNESS via TTL/ETag selective invalidation as distinct from behavioral gating. Justifies promoting MEA harness + TTL probe as product lever vs selector cache despite Stagehand dominance at exact repeat. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion; replication with production Docker full-DOM 2000-node BrowserGym 1280x720 + real gpt-4o-mini tokens/browser calls and distributed-store required before promotion. Use measured per_hit ratios/probe_saving/auditor_precision as pricing prior and Pareto frontier (accuracy vs total cost vs median latency, tokens/browser/latency/retrieval/verification/probe/auditor) for commercial viability.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED (controls PASS non-vacuous but any per_hit parity vs RAG/Stagehand/TERX fails where they honestly hit under QCR, or probe_false_accept>=0.05, or curated vs uncurated delta null): governed-memory pivot as ported does not yield residual-novelty-proportional compression on this census vs retrievable RAG or shipped Stagehand cache; either MEA overhead (100 tok audit) dominates saving, or TTL probe does not dominate adaptive Jaccard, or curated exploration does not improve verified coverage, or 71.8% UNKNOWN vacuity persists even with external state. Product must NOT claim pay-cost-of-novelty for C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY via this harness on this setting; acknowledge Stagehand DOM-hash 80% speedup remains dominant at exact repeat and RAG proportional retrievable at n0.25 remains strong baseline where SPIDER fails. Keep exact-intent or per-site mapping; prioritize kernel freshness/delta-repair or semantic-resolve orthogonal levers or Frontier critique-reconstruct adapter improvements before revisiting economics. Bounded REJECTED for MEA+TTL probe proxy setting only, not global falsification of C-PRODUCT-ECON (strategy may transfer with richer DOM/QCR post-retrieval or distributed substrate). No promotion; Pareto will show where cost accumulates (auditor/probe/retrieval/distill). If MIXED (some per_hit pass, others fail) keep HYPOTHESIS and investigate constant overhead dominance vs per_hit isolation.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate file-based primary: 192 tasks 36 families x5 conditions (COLD/RAG/Stagehand/TERX/SPIDER-MEA) +4 controls (~576) = ~1536 deterministic resolve/_bind/MEA_verify/TTL_probe trials plus curated vs uncurated ablation (~192) plus TFIDF offline and non-deterministic mock wrong-bound p=0.15 branches. No Docker required for primary gate. Wall <50min CPU proxy (<90min if Playwright 2000-node 1280x720 loopback exercised). Storage per-task CSV ~1700 rows, registry JSONL, cost_config, branch_traces with probe/auditor flags, qcr_bank_manifest, provenance. If Docker+gpt-4o-mini exploratory enabled: 192 tasks x5 x~15 steps Playwright ~3000 browser calls, ~2000 gpt-4o-mini calls <$15, plus BrowserGym 2000-node snapshot storage. No LLM keys required for proxy decision; ~$12-15 if real LLM exploratory.
expected_information_gain: Very high: Director-mandated PIVOTSSS gate that directly tests whether pivoting leverage from slot parameterization (FALSIFIED 3 prior PIVOT-scale, rho_novelty 0.82 binary artifact, 71.8% UNKNOWN, SPIDER/RAG 1.57 at n0.25) to governed-memory (MEA fresh-context+external verified state before update, addressing 25k+ context rot and loop compounding) plus cheap TTL/ETag SWR verification probe (dominating adaptive Jaccard per priors, probe 10 tok vs full 50 tok) achieves the honest-cost per_hit targets parameterization never met (<=0.85x RAG at n0 and n0.25, <=1.20x Stagehand at n0, <1.0x TERX at n>=0.25 with ECE<=0.15) under QCR frozen-bank same-ranker, family-stratified bootstrap/permutation 5000, honest 50-tok hit accounting, critique-reconstruct retrieval+reconstruction, and 2000-node DOM-hash. Prior 27+ product experiments are MEASUREMENT_INVALID or FALSIFIED on file proxy; this is first test of orthogonal Scout-identified MemGuard/VerMem + Stagehand 80% caching strong baseline with governed provenance vs slot induction. Either valid positive (per_hit beating retrievable RAG where parameterization lost 57% overhead) or valid negative (MEA overhead dominates even with 30% probe saving) definitively decides Product architecture: continue mechanism distillation vs selector cache vs fine-tuning, and whether C-PRODUCT-ECON Docker scale-up justified vs premature, providing DolphinBench-style Pareto (accuracy vs tokens vs browser+latency, decomposed retrieval/verification/probe/auditor/distill) for commercial viability without another MEASUREMENT_INVALID loop.
